acceptanceCriteria.description: Landing page loads successfully with no console errors.
acceptanceCriteria.test: Open the page in a browser and check console for errors.

acceptanceCriteria.description: Hero section displays with animated gradient background.
acceptanceCriteria.test: Visual inspection that the hero has a gradient animation.

acceptanceCriteria.description: Features section displays at least 3 feature cards.
acceptanceCriteria.test: Check that the features grid contains at least 3 cards.
Click next/prev buttons and verify testimonial changes.
Enter invalid email and submit; error message should appear.

acceptanceCriteria.description: Contact form shows success message on valid submission.
acceptanceCriteria.test: Submit valid data and verify success message.

acceptanceCriteria.description: Page is responsive on mobile and desktop.
acceptanceCriteria.test: Resize browser and verify layout adapts.
